stem: An audit of S3 lifecycle rules finds a bucket that has to delete incomplete multipart uploads after 7 days and permanently remove noncurrent object versions after 90 days. Select TWO actions the rule needs. (Select TWO.)

choices.text: A transition action to Glacier Deep Archive
An S3 Object Lock retention rule
A replication rule to a second bucket
An expiration action for incomplete multipart uploads
An expiration action for noncurrent versions

rationale: An expiration action targeting incomplete multipart uploads removes the abandoned parts after the stated number of days, stopping the storage they would otherwise keep billing for. A second expiration action targeting noncurrent versions permanently removes older versions once they pass the stated age. A transition action changes an object's storage class; it does not delete anything, so it cannot satisfy either deletion requirement. S3 Object Lock enforces retention and legal holds, preventing deletion rather than scheduling it. A replication rule copies objects to another bucket and has no expiration behavior at all.
